answer_key_audit.notes: Confirmed: at the reviewed head (0a741933beb6) gstack-prose-lint with --sections and --gate printed PROSE_LINT: none and exited 0 when a file had none of the named headings, and the head's test pinned that ('--sections Nope --gate' gives none). The fix adds a check after the lintFiles call (lines 56-57) that exits 2 so 'a renamed heading cannot pass unread', and rewrites the test to expect exit 2. The /ship compose gate runs this command with --sections ... --gate, so a draft that lost its headings published unlinted. Needs human check: severity (no rating for this issue in the receipt, and no failing test or production break named beyond the test the fix rewrites.).
